body:
My name is...M...we'll just leave it at that. I usually stick to the opiates, but I dabble in the occasional upper, like provigil, adderall, etc. Again, I'd like to say that an upper has to do something pretty damn good to get me to my desired level of euphoria. I prefer the sleep-filled, comfortable, euphoric state of my opiates, than a sleepless amphetamine high.
Modafinil is a very powerful drug. I take 1600mg+ throughout the course of a night. The most I every took was 3200mg, and I like absolute shit the next day. All I did was lay in my bed not eating or sleeping.
[Erowid Note: 
The dose described in this report is very high, potentially beyond Erowid's 'heavy' range, and could pose serious health risks or result in unwanted, extreme effects. Sometimes extremely high doses reported are errors rather than actual doses used.]
03/29/06~~7:30p.m.-1:30a.m.
Alright, I took 1600mg of provigil, and 30mg of adderall. This night kicked ass, except for the lack of sleep, which I can't stand, but it comes with the territory( amphetamines that is ). The euphoria is great and it lasted long as hell. There are a lot of negative effects of this particular drug though. For example stomach pains, nausea, throbbing headaches, restlessness, inability to sit still, irritability, etc. Don't get the wrong idea, I just take too much. You can have a great time with this drug if you use it moderation.
